input.command: cd $CLONE; wc -l README.md; grep -n '^#\|tune' README.md; ls; ls .markdown-lint-on-edit DRIFT-CHECK.md CHANGE-VALIDATION.md 2>&1; grep -rln 'tune' yf/src | head -20
cd $CLONE; grep -n -i 'tune' -A3 yf/src/cli.rs | head -150; cat DRIFT-CHECK.md | sed -n '/§6\|Trigger Scope/,/^## /p' | head -40
cd $CLONE; sed -n 80,190p yf/src/cli.rs; ls target/debug/yf target/release/yf 2>&1; grep -n 'README' DRIFT-CHECK.md CHANGE-VALIDATION.md | head
cd $CLONE; wc -l web/content/pages/harness-tune.md; cat web/content/pages/harness-tune.md; ./target/debug/yf harness tune --help
cd $CLONE; grep -n 'harness.is_empty\|detect' yf/src/cmd/harness/mod.rs | head -20; grep -n 'yes' yf/src/cmd/harness/mod.rs | head; grep -n 'yes' yf/src/cli.rs | sed -n 1,20p
